result: Implemented focusa.mission_canvas.registry.list as a fail-closed Core-read operation requiring mission_canvas:read and exact Workstream authority, returning typed RegistryEntry[] through the generated API surface with builtin and persisted registry merge plus strict persistence identity checks.
implementation: API route now enforces mission_canvas:read permission and exact Workstream scope validation for registry.list.
Route returns direct RegistryEntry[] via generated validator types and serializes canonical registry documents only.
Persisted registry documents are validated for required metadata and identity integrity using registry_catalog_invalid and registry_catalog_identity_mismatch checks.
Unsupported registry kinds now return an explicit registry_kind_unknown error; supported builtin registries return builtin defaults while custom overlay entries can extend them by entry_id.
Desktop runtime now has explicit registryList coverage in generated-operation consumer with path-parameter, transport schema, empty-result, hostile-response, and authority failure assertions.
presentation_contract: Desktop consumes generated registryList and uses no local registry-kind heuristics; it does not infer panels, renderers, or registry content locally.
negative_cases: foreign or mismatched Workstream in response
permission denied or host-workstream mismatch from transport
acceptance: registry.list returns direct RegistryEntry[] only when scope is exact and permission is present.
Unknown registry kinds are rejected as unsupported (registry_kind_unknown) and malformed persisted documents are rejected fail-closed.
Desktop operation coverage asserts generated request/response behavior and strict hostile-response rejection.
